Release notes

All notable changes to the Widget client are documented here. The format follows the keep-a-changelog conventions, and releases follow semantic versioning.

Version 2.4.0

Released on 2024-09-12

  • Added streaming downloads for archives larger than one gigabyte, with resumable transfers and checksum verification.
  • Added a doctor command that checks binary integrity, token scope, and network reachability in one pass.
  • Changed the default retry policy to use exponential backoff with jitter and a hard cap of three attempts.
  • Fixed a race condition where two concurrent login commands could overwrite the token file and corrupt the profile.

Version 2.3.1

24 July 2024

  • Fixed an encoding bug that corrupted non-ASCII filenames when extracting archives on Windows systems.
  • Improved error messages for expired tokens, including the exact expiry timestamp and a hint to re-authenticate.
  • Updated the bundled certificate store and removed two roots that had been retired by their operators.
